spans.s: भुक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Eaten; 2. enjoyed; 3. experienced, suffered; 4. possessed (in law), (pp. of भुज् q.v.).
भुक्त (II) n. 1. The act of eating; 2. the place where anybody has eaten; 3. anything eaten.
भुक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Eaten; 2. enjoyed; 3. experienced, suffered; 4. possessed (in law), (pp. of भुज् q.v.).
भुक्त-उच्छिष्ट n. the remnants of food eaten.
भुक्त-भोग a. 1. one who has enjoyed or suffered anything; 2. (anything) that has been used or enjoyed.
भुक्त-शेष, -समुज्झित n. remnants of the food eaten, leavings.
भुक्त-शेष, -समुज्झित n. remnants of the food eaten, leavings.
भुक्त-सुप्त a. sleeping after a meal.
भुक्ति f. 1. Eating or enjoying; 2. possession, usufruct (in law), Yaj.ii.22; 3. food; 4. the diurnal motion of a planet (in astronomy).
भुक्ति-प्रद m. a species of plant (मुद्ग).
भू-कदंब m. a species of kadamba tree.
भू-कर्ण m. the diameter of the earth.
भू-कश्यप m. an epithet of Vasudeva, Kṛṣṇa’s father.
भू-काक m. 1. the curlew; 2. a kind of pigeon; 3. a kind of heron.
भू-केश m. the Indian fig tree.
भूक m.n. 1. A cavity, a hole; 2. a spring; 3. time.
